name: Dimitrios Papadopoulos
bio:
Dimitrios' journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines in his family's garage in Thessaloniki. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from the Aristotle University, he cut his teeth in smaller racing teams, steadily climbing the ranks through sheer dedication and a keen eye for detail. His experience ranges from managing logistics to overseeing technical developments, making him uniquely suited to the multifaceted role of Head of Operations.

At Ferrari AF Corse, Dimitrios is known for his meticulous planning and ability to remain calm under pressure. He believes in empowering his team members, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives. What sets him apart is his relentless pursuit of marginal gains, constantly seeking improvements in every aspect of the team's operations, from pit stop efficiency to data analysis strategies. He strives to create a smooth and effective environment for his team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Dimitrios is of average height with a serious and focused demeanor, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Insists on drinking Greek coffee precisely at 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM every day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
